newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 1996 BEER PRODUCTION VOLUME FELL - BREWERS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 1996 BEER PRODUCTION VOLUME FELL - BREWERS.

text.p: Finnish production of beer fell one percent last year to 467 million litres from 473 million litres in 1995, the federation of Finnish brewers said in a statement on Friday.
High beer tax boosted private imports of foreign brands, causing production to fall, it said.
The federation said a survey by Gallup Finland showed that private imports of beer rose 54 percent last year.
